# fct_itinerary_events

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_itinerary_events` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for user behavior events interacting with itineraries (such as a page load or button click). Each row represents a single event fired related to the itineraries feature. Sourced from Segment.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `event_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID assigned to each event. Created by Segment >> SOURCE - Segment data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `anonymous_id` | Foreign Key. Segment's default user identifier that tracks visitors before authentication. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `blended_user_id` | Foreign Key. The identifier used for sessionization. If an event cannot be attributed to a user, the field uses Segment's anonymous_id, otherwise it's the same as the user_id. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `block_type` | The type of block component (page, title, header, etc). >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `event_at` | Timestamp of when the event occurred. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `event_metadata` | Additional descriptive information related to the event. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `event_name` | The name of the event, generally named using the following convention - Page/Feature/Action. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `itinerary_client_page_view` | Returns (1) if the event is a 'client page view', (0) if it is not. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `itinerary_client_page_pdf_export` | Returns (1) if the event is a 'client page PDF export', (0) if it is not. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `itinerary_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID assigned to each itinerary. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `itinerary_page_created` | Returns (1) if the event is an 'itinerary page creation', (0) if it is not. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `itinerary_page_deleted` | Returns (1) if the event is an 'itinerary page deletion', (0) if it is not. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `itinerary_page_duplicated` | Returns (1) if the event is an 'itinerary page duplication', (0) if it is not. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_path` | The destination path of the event's URL, such as '/partners/hotels'. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_query_string` | The query string (after the '?') in the event's URL. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_subdomain` | The subdomain of the URL. Examples include advisor or trips. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_title` | The title of the event's page; comes from the <title> in the HTML. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_url` | The path + query string of event's URL. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_view_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID assigned to each page view using the page sequence, user_id, and page path. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `user_id` | Foreign Key. The 'User ID' in the Portal database. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `session_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID assigned to each session using the session sequence and user_id. >> SOURCE - Segment |
